chooseResponse.q: What will you do this weekend?

conversation.transcript:
Student: I heard there's a new biology lab opening next week.
Advisor: Yes, it's designed for hands-on experiments. Have you signed up for a session?
Student: Not yet. Is there a limit on how many people can join?
Advisor: There is. I recommend signing up soon to secure your spot.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
questions.explain: 這段對話的主要主題是關於新的生物實驗室。

questions.q: What should the student do to ensure participation?
questions.explain: 學生應該儘早報名以確保參加。

announcement.transcript: Attention students: The university library will be extending its hours starting next Monday. The new hours will be from 8 AM to 10 PM on weekdays. This change is aimed at providing more access to study resources, especially during finals week. We hope to see you there!

questions.q: What is the purpose of the announcement?
questions.explain: 這個公告的目的是關於圖書館的開放時間變更。

questions.q: When will the new library hours start?
questions.explain: 新的圖書館開放時間將於下週一開始。

talk.transcript: Today, I will discuss the concept of renewable energy. Renewable energy comes from natural sources that can be replenished. This includes solar energy from the sun, wind energy generated by wind turbines, and hydropower from flowing water. These sources are sustainable and can significantly reduce our reliance on fossil fuels. Additionally, using renewable energy helps to decrease greenhouse gas emissions, combating climate change. As technology advances, the efficiency and accessibility of these energy sources continue to improve, making them an essential part of our future energy landscape.

questions.explain: 可再生能源是來自可補充的自然資源。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a source of renewable energy?
questions.explain: 天然氣不是可再生能源的來源。

questions.q: What is one benefit of using renewable energy?
questions.explain: 使用可再生能源的好處之一是減少對化石燃料的依賴。

questions.q: How does technology affect renewable energy?
options: It eliminates the need for it.
questions.explain: 技術進步提高了可再生能源的效率和可獲得性。
